body: Chief: your new hold on embed-core privacy.scala/receipt.scala/PrivacySuite/ADR is fine as a reservation, but do NOT edit those files in the shared tree yet — P0-2 (41ebdb8, under final review, ack imminent) rewrites all of them and will land as a merge from m1's branch; shared-tree edits now would collide with that merge.
